scope: All locally generated questions from the three complete sample passages and docs/demo-input.txt; prepared sample questions are not scored.

definitions.answer_leak: Question-level: the correct blank word still appears as a case-insensitive whole token anywhere in the complete prompt, including its instruction line.
definitions.ambiguity_proxy: Question-level: at least one distractor appears as a case-insensitive whole token in the same concept's source quote. This is source co-occurrence, not proof of multiple semantically correct answers.
definitions.no_pos_or_length_match: Distractor-level: both its coarse word-class guess differs from the answer's and its character length differs by more than two. Either matching dimension prevents this flag.
definitions.pos_heuristic: A small declared verb list and ordered suffix rules, with a noun-like fallback. No contextual POS tagger, model download, or new dependency. Categories can be wrong, particularly for words with multiple grammatical uses.
definitions.length_heuristic: Length matches when the absolute character-count difference is at most two; this cutoff is an unvalidated descriptive heuristic.

limitations: Four development passages are not an independent or representative benchmark.
Flags are reproducible diagnostics, not model accuracy, teaching quality, or learning-outcome measurements.
Source co-occurrence can flag a distractor even when it cannot grammatically or semantically fill the blank.
The POS/length heuristic can miss poor distractors or flag acceptable ones; inspect the included question-level details.
The earlier 13/13 quote and 31/31 question results are grounding checks that hold by construction, not evidence of question quality.
